subject: BridgeWave marketplace bundle reconciliation and co-sell mapping
messages:
From: Lara Zhou <lara@bridgewave.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BridgeWave marketplace bundle reconciliation and co-sell mapping

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We pushed a first cut of our bundled SKU catalog into AWS and Azure this morning and are seeing two problems we hoped Redwood could help with: 1) SKU split mismatch between marketplaces (some of our bundled SKUs are being broken into per-feature SKUs on Azure, which breaks our pricing thresholds), and 2) co-sell/private-offer mapping is out of sync — the cloud listing IDs you have for our private-offer tests don't match the manifest your integration expects.

Quick summary: attached is the bundle matrix (bridgewave-bundle-matrix.csv) that shows the intended bundle -> marketplace-SKU mapping and the anomalies we observed. We also included a short sample of metering lines where usage attribution looks dropped.

As next steps can you:
- Confirm whether Redwood can preserve bundle boundaries for "BW-Core+Tools" and "BW-Analytics" across AWS/Azure?
- Share the list of evidence you need for co-sell uplift and private-offer mapping (billing proof, demo recordings, entitlement mapping).
- Propose a 30-minute timebox this week to align owners.

We're under a timebox — our channel team wants a resolved mapping before the private-offer window opens on May 20.

Attachments: bridgewave-bundle-matrix.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Thanks,
Lara Zhou
Head of Partnerships | BridgeWave
lara@bridgewave.io
(415) 555-0118

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Lara Zhou <lara@bridgewave.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeWave marketplace bundle reconciliation and co-sell mapping

Lara — great summary and thanks for the attachment. Looping Ben and Kimberly to scope the work and own marketplace touchpoints.

High level I expect the mismatch is coming from two places: 1) our catalog routing rules that split by SKU dimension (we can pin bundle=unit at listing time), and 2) marketplace-specific entitlement translation logic (Azure has a known edge where pre-bundled metering sometimes flattens). We can reconcile both but need a couple of artifacts from your side and a rapid triage call.

Can you share:
- The canonical bundle->product-id table (CSV is perfect).
- A short excerpt of the marketplace manifest (the one you submitted to AWS/Azure).
- Any private-offer DocuSign or marketplace window dates if you have them.

Proposal: 30-min sync Tue May 14 10:00 PT. If that works we’ll treat this as a short sprint: Ben will do entitlement mapping and a first-pass SKU translation; Kimberly will own catalog listing changes and private-offer wiring with marketplace teams; I’ll own the co-sell evidence checklist and the HubSpot deal upgrade.

Action items I’m taking now:
- I’ll create a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot task list for the evidence items.
- Ben/Kimberly: can you confirm you have capacity to start Monday and review the CSV?

Lara: thanks — linking Redwood co-sell doc for what we typically require: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BridgeWaveOnboarding (private link).

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

[forwarded above]

Team — short and tactical: we have a May 20 private-offer window and BridgeWave needs clean bundle->sku alignment and co-sell evidence before then. Please take ownership of the asks below.

Ben: entitlement mapping & translation (AWS + Azure). Deliverable: sku-translation-draft.xlsx with mapping and recommended pinning rules. Coordinate with marketplaces for private-offer mapping.
Kimberly: listing & private-offer wiring — confirm whether the Azure catalog will accept pre-bundled SKUs or we need a prep step. Deliverable: marketplace-change-log.md and the private-offer submission checklist.
Vivek: I’ll own the evidence checklist and HubSpot updates — I need the list of artifacts we ask for (SOC2, architecture diagram, demo clip, billing sample, metering logs).

Timeline: initial pass by EOD Mon May 13, sync Tue May 14 10:00 PT, final handoff Wed May 15 so BridgeWave can submit before May 20.

Attachments to request from BridgeWave: marketplace manifest, billing sample, docuSign window, partner legal contact.

— Vivek

- In progress: Azure ruleset (sheet: AZ-translation) — hitting the flattening behavior on two BW bundles, need the marketplace manifest to validate.
- Need from BridgeWave: the exact manifest they pushed and one week of metering lines (CSV).

Attachments: sku-translation-draft.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB), private-offer-template.docx (DOCX, 34KB)

Will be on the call 10:00 PT.
